# [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#api-overview)  API Overview

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#base-url)  Base URL

All requests use the following base URL:

```
https://www.designarena.ai/api/v1
```

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#authentication)  Authentication

All API requests require authentication using a Bearer token.

curl

JavaScript

Python

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_your_api_key_here" \
  https://www.designarena.ai/api/v1/leaderboard/models/website
```

```
fetch('https://www.designarena.ai/api/v1/leaderboard/models/website', {
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer sk_live_your_api_key_here' }
})
```

```
requests.get(url, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer sk_live_your_api_key_here'})
```

### [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#getting-an-api-key)  Getting an API Key

1. Apply at [designarena.ai/developers/apply](https://designarena.ai/developers/apply)
2. Describe your use case and agree to the attribution requirements
3. We’ll review and email you your API key (usually 1-2 business days)

Keep your API key secret. Never expose it in client-side code, public repositories, or share it publicly.

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#endpoints)  Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | [`/arenas`](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/arenas) | List all arenas and categories |
| `GET` | [`/models`](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/models) | All models with rankings across every arena/category |
| `GET` | [`/leaderboard/{arena}/{category}`](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/leaderboard) | Get leaderboard for a specific arena and category |

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#rate-limits)  Rate Limits

We do not currently enforce strict rate limits, but please be reasonable. We reserve the right to revoke keys that abuse the service.

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#caching)  Caching

To ensure performance, responses are cached:

- **Models & Leaderboard** — CDN cached for **5 minutes**, stale-while-revalidate up to 10 minutes
- **Arenas** — CDN cached for **1 hour**, stale-while-revalidate up to 2 hours

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#error-codes)  Error Codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Invalid `arena` or `category` parameter |
| `401` | Missing API key (no `Authorization` header) |
| `403` | Invalid or revoked API key |
| `500` | Server error |

### [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#error-response-format)  Error Response Format

```
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_API_KEY",
    "message": "The provided API key is invalid or has been revoked"
  }
}
```

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#data-volatility)  Data Volatility

Leaderboard rankings update in real-time throughout the day as new battles are recorded. Models within the same performance band may swap positions frequently. However, models that are significantly better—or in a clearly different tier—tend to remain stable within their band.

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#supported-arenas-&-categories)  Supported Arenas & Categories

Use `GET /arenas` to retrieve this list programmatically. The API returns **display names** (e.g. `Website`, `Models Arena`) in responses, but the leaderboard endpoint accepts both display names and internal slugs as path parameters.

| Arena | Display Name | Categories (slug → display name) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `models` | Models Arena | `codecategories` → Code Categories, `website` → Website, `gamedev` → Game Dev, `3d` → 3D Design, `dataviz` → Data Visualization, `uicomponent` → UI Component, `image` → Image, `logo` → Logo, `graphicdesign` → Graphic Design, `svg` → SVG, `ascii` → ASCII Art, `video` → Video, `videotovideo` → Video Editing, `imagetovideo` → Image to Video, `multitovideo` → Multi to Video, `multimodaltovideo` → Multimodal to Video, `imagetoimage` → Image Editing, `slides` → Slides, `tts` → Text-to-Speech, `sts` → Voice Chat, `music` → Music, `conversation` → Conversation, `stt` → Speech-to-Text, `worldmodel` → World Model |
| `builders` | Builders Arena | `website` → Website |
| `agents` | Agents Arena | `agon_webapps` → Web Apps, `mobileapps` → Mobile Apps, `nativeapps` → Android Native, `fullstack` → Fullstack, `agentic_gamedev` → Agentic Game Dev, `agon_godot` → Godot Game Dev, `agentic_3d` → Agentic 3D, `agon_slides` → Agentic Slides |

`Code Categories` (slug: `codecategories`) aggregates stats across all code generation categories: Website, 3D Design, Data Visualization, Game Dev, and UI Component.

## [​](https://docs.designarena.ai/api-reference/overview\#openrouter-model-mapping)  OpenRouter Model Mapping

Every leaderboard entry includes an `openRouterId` field that maps to OpenRouter’s model identifier. This enables you to cross-reference Design Arena rankings with OpenRouter metadata (pricing, context windows, etc.).

- **`openRouterId: "anthropic/claude-opus-4.6"`** — model is available on OpenRouter
- **`openRouterId: null`** — model is not available on OpenRouter (proprietary platforms, image/video generators, deprecated models)
